I would definitely purchase it again.

Licensed Cosmetologist 25yrs here: The product had rave reviews so I decided to try. Read package instructions carefully. Skin will tighten then pulsate as stated in directions. I used a plastic container to mix equal parts of clay and bottled H2O. 1tblsp clay + 1tblsp H2O is an adequate amount to cover your entire face. Do a gentle face cleanse first & towel blot gently. Mix carefully then so ply mask with a sanitized foundation brush to your damp face for an even spread. Warning: Avoid under eye area completely. I set my timer for 15min as my skin is EXTREMELY OILY. I boiled hot water and doused it over a sanitary washcloth to remove clay from my face then pat dry with a sanitary hand towel. After, I applied my daily moisturizer. The results: My oily, acneic skin feels AMAAAAZING. I recommend this process at night, and sleep on a freshly washed/dried pillowcase. Notes: redness is normal after any mask, so reduce your time or discontinue use if your skin is overly irritated. I recommend ONLY for oily/acne skin.
